name: smart-art
description: Smart Art – AI art coach progressive web app (student, parent and admin)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:push -w server && npm run seed -w server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.vercel-build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server && npm run db:push -w server -- --skip-generate && node server/dist/seed.js
